name: agent-1-trend-analyst-v1
description: Trend Analyst v1 — Mexican HNW fragrance signals daily at 08:00 UTC (02:00 CDMX) via OpenAI Responses+web_search; validates canonical taxonomy, persists known signals + unknown candidates, updates run_logs.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent.run_logs (
  id,
  run_id,
  agent,
  status,
  started_at,
  metadata
) VALUES (
  $1,
  $1,
  $2,
  'started',
  $3::timestamptz,
  $4::jsonb
);

UPDATE agent.run_logs
SET
  status = 'failed',
  finished_at = now(),
  duration_ms = (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::int,
  errors_count = 1,
  metadata = metadata || $2::jsonb
WHERE run_id = $1 AND status = 'started';

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Generate runId').item.json.runId }},{{ JSON.stringify({ error: $json.error || 'unknown', parseFailedAt: new Date().toISOString(), rawSnippet: ($json.rawJsonString || '').slice(0, 200) }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const unknowns = $('Validate and Filter').first().json.unknown || [];

return unknowns.map(u => ({ json: u }));

parameters.query:
UPDATE agent.run_logs
SET
  status = 'succeeded',
  finished_at = now(),
  duration_ms = (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - started_at)) * 1000)::int,
  signals_processed = $2::int,
  metadata = metadata || $3::jsonb
WHERE run_id = $1 AND status = 'started';

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Generate runId').item.json.runId }},{{ $('Validate and Filter').first().json.counts.known }},{{ JSON.stringify({ totalSignals: $('Validate and Filter').first().json.totalSignals, counts: $('Validate and Filter').first().json.counts, completedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
